nodes.summary: Placeholder hardware identity for results a third party reported without publishing the host. It exists so that a source-reported number can still be stored as a reified hyperedge with an honest hardware anchor instead of being silently attached to a real machine. Nothing measured here transfers without re-measurement.

nodes.summary: The challenge operator's ranked evaluation host. Every official_verified score in this graph was produced here, not on a contributor machine. The exact chip, memory, macOS build, and thermal state are not disclosed to participants, so transfer from these results to a named local host is an inference, never a measurement. Treating this as an opaque but stable hardware identity is what makes the official scores comparable to each other and incomparable to local timings.
